description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom TextView widget for displaying log data received through the LogNode interface in an Android application. It formats log messages with priority, tag, message, and exceptions, and supports chaining to other LogNode objects.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView widget that outputs log data formatted for display, implementing the LogNode interface for chaining log outputs.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and displays a log message with priority, tag, message, and throwable, and passes it to next LogNode if available.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Appends a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Outputs a string as a new line to the LogView.
